references.title: Fitting using finite Monte Carlo samples
references.applicability: Next-stage finite-template auxiliary likelihood candidate; normalized continuous weighted columns and unknown alpha require explicit validation, not blind independent-Poisson cell substitution.

references.title: A binned likelihood for stochastic models
references.authors: C. A. Argüelles, A. Schneider and T. Yuan
references.applicability: Motivates MC-aware coverage and interval-width validation. This stage isolates independent sampling layers and checks truth-point delta covariance; it does not implement this likelihood.
